cases.text: Selling 178.4121 rHIMS. My taker fee is 0.08%, I won't accept more than 0.5% all-in cost, and I must be flat before Oct 8.
cases.note: All four. 'before Oct 8' excludes the 8th.

cases.text: sell 250 rNVDA, 8bp taker, cap 30bp all in, out by fri hard
cases.note: All four. 'by fri' = next Friday after Sat Oct 3 = Oct 9, inclusive. 'hard' = must.

cases.text: Hi, I'd like to buy rSPY with 1000 USDT. I pay 10 basis points as taker. I'd prefer total costs to stay under 40bp.
cases.note: Quote-sized buy, no deadline.

cases.text: maker is 2bp, I pay 8bp taker. dumping 40 rTSLA, max half a percent total, need to be done by the 9th.
cases.note: Two fees; only the 8bp taker is theirs. 'half a percent' = 50. 'need to be done by' = must. All four.

cases.text: Don't want to pay more than 0.4% all in on this rAAPL sale, 120 shares. Fee's 0.1% taker.
cases.note: Ceiling phrased as negation.

cases.text: My friend pays 6bp taker on Bitget, not sure what mine is. Want to sell 33.5 rMSFT, keep it under 0.3% all-in.
cases.note: The 6bp fee is someone else's; trader's own fee unknown.

cases.text: sell 500 rAMD, fee is 10, sorry, 8bps taker. ceiling 60bp. must be out by the 12th
cases.note: Corrected fee 10 -> 8. Bare '12th' = 2026-10-12. All four.

cases.text: rNVDA up 4.5% today lol, have to take profit on 75 shares before Tuesday, 8 basis points taker
cases.note: 4.5% is a price move, not a cost; no ceiling. Next Tuesday = Oct 6, 'before' excludes it.

cases.text: Selling 90 rGOOGL but not before the 8th, earnings play. taker 0.06%. max 35bp.
cases.note: 'not before the 8th' is an earliest date, not a deadline.

cases.text: Was supposed to be out of my 64 rMETA by Friday but that's cancelled, I can hold through whenever. Taker is 8 bps.
cases.note: Deadline explicitly no longer applies; can hold -> mustBeFlat false.

cases.text: hey what's the deal with rTokens, are they actually backed? thinking about it
cases.note: Nothing extractable.

cases.text: ok so i got 1,250.5 rSPY i need to unload and my takr fee is 0.08% and honestly i dont wanna eat more than like 0.45% total and i HAVE to be flat by oct 16 no exceptions
cases.note: Run-on with typo; thousands separator stripped. All four.

cases.text: Buy 2500 USDT of rQQQ. Taker 8bp. Max cost 25 bps.
cases.note: Terse quote-sized buy.

cases.text: Need to sell 18 rCOST before Wednesday, must be completely out. Cost ceiling 0.35%.
cases.note: Next Wednesday = Oct 7, 'before' excludes it. No fee stated.

cases.text: Selling 300 rINTC on or before October 20. Optional though, if the spread is ugly I'll just hold. 10bps taker fee, budget 50bp all in.
cases.note: All four. Deadline stated but optional -> mustBeFlat false. Debatable whether an optional date counts as hardDeadlineNy; kept per the 'optional' rule.

cases.text: VIP1 so my taker is 0.08%; the standard 0.1% taker doesn't apply to me. Selling 45.25 rNFLX, ceiling 0.6%.
cases.note: Two taker rates; only 0.08% is theirs.

cases.text: Sell 100 rBA by next Friday, max 40bp, 8bp taker.
cases.note: 'next Friday' said on a Saturday is ambiguous (Oct 9 or Oct 16) -> null.

cases.text: dump 60 rPLTR by the 2nd, 8 bps taker, cap 50bp, must be out
cases.note: Bare '2nd' already passed this month -> next 2nd on/after today = Nov 2. All four. Debatable: real trader may have meant a typo.

cases.text: Please buy rSPY for 500 USDT before the 7th. My taker fee is 8 basis points and I'd like the all-in cost to be no more than 0.2%.
cases.note: Buy with deadline; mustBeFlat not stated. 'before the 7th' -> Oct 6.

cases.text: rMSTR 12 shares sell, fee 0.12% taker, ceiling 80 bps, have to be done by Monday
cases.note: All four. Next Monday = Oct 5.

cases.text: 我要卖出 178.4121 股 rHIMS，吃单手续费千分之0.8，总成本不能超过千分之五，必须在10月8日之前清仓。
cases.note: All four. 10月8日之前 excludes the 8th.

cases.text: 帮我买入 rSPY，花 1000 USDT，吃单费率万8，总成本控制在0.3%以内。
cases.note: 万8 = 8bps.

cases.text: 卖200股rNVDA，手续费万分之八，最多接受50个基点的成本，周五前必须全部卖完。
cases.note: All four. 周五前 treated as exclusive per rule -> Oct 8. Debatable: colloquial 周五前 is often inclusive.

cases.text: 挂单费率万2，我吃单是万8。卖出 50 股 rTSLA，总成本不超过千分之四。
cases.note: Maker 万2 is not the taker fee.

cases.text: 我朋友吃单费是万6，我的不清楚。想卖 30 股 rAAPL，成本别超过0.5%。
cases.note: Fee belongs to a friend.

cases.text: 卖出 80 股 rAMD，手续费0.1%，不对，是0.08%。成本上限千分之六，10月12日（含）之前必须出完。
cases.note: Corrected fee 10 -> 8. （含） makes the 12th inclusive. All four.

cases.text: rNVDA今天涨了5%，我想把手上的 100 股卖掉，吃单手续费万分之八。
cases.note: 5% is a price move, not a ceiling.

cases.text: 15号以后再卖，不要在15号之前卖。120股rGOOGL，费率千分之一。
cases.note: Earliest date, not a deadline. 千分之一 = 10bps.

cases.text: 本来要求周三以前清仓的，现在不用了，可以继续拿着。持有 64 股 rMETA，吃单费万8。
cases.note: Deadline cancelled; can hold -> false. sizeShares from holding being discussed; debatable since no explicit sell instruction.

cases.text: rToken 是什么？跟普通股票有什么区别？
cases.note: Nothing extractable.

cases.text: 帮我用 2500 USDT 买 rQQQ，最晚10月9日买到，总成本不超过25个基点。
cases.note: 最晚 = inclusive. No fee.

cases.note: All four. 以前 excludes the 20th. Optional -> false.

cases.text: rCOST 卖18股 吃单万5 成本上限万分之三十五 周三前必须出
cases.note: All four. 万分之三十五 = 35. 周三前 exclusive -> Oct 6 (same caveat as P23).

cases.text: 月底之前处理掉 45 股 rNFLX，吃单万8，成本别超千分之六。
cases.note: '月底之前' is ambiguous (Oct 30, Oct 31, or day before month-end) -> null. Debatable.

cases.text: 您好，我想卖出 1250.5 股 rSPY。我的吃单手续费是0.08%，可接受的总成本最高0.45%。必须在16号之前全部卖出。
cases.note: All four. Bare 16号之前 -> Oct 15.

cases.text: sell 250 rNVDA, taker 万8, all-in 不超过 30bp, Friday 前必须 flat
cases.note: All four. 'Friday 前' exclusive -> Oct 8.

cases.text: maker 0.02%, taker 0.08%，我是 taker。买 rSPY 1000U, cost cap 千分之三
cases.note: Two fees; '1000U' = 1000 USDT.

cases.text: 帮我 sell 40 rTSLA by Oct 9, fee 8bp, 最多 half a percent, 可以 hold 过去 if needed
cases.note: All four. Can hold through -> false.
